//@version=6
// ============================================================
//  QUANT PRIME · RESEARCH BUILD RES-2101
//  Weekly Open + EMA Ribbon + Weekly Summary
//  Weekly open line, EMA ribbon (4 layer), Weekly analysis template
//
//  Generated file. Do not edit.
//  Edit the source piece and regenerate.
//  quantprime.uk
// ============================================================
indicator("QP RES-2101 · Weekly Open + EMA Ribbon + Weekly Summary", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500, max_bars_back = 500)

// ---------- STARTER ----------
st2_on  = input.bool(true,     "Show weekly open",  group = "Starter · Weekly open")
st2_col = input.color(#c9a84c, "Weekly open colour", group = "Starter · Weekly open")
st2_wid = input.int(1, "Weekly open width", minval = 1, maxval = 4, group = "Starter · Weekly open")

st2_o = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", open, lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

plot(st2_on ? st2_o : na, "Weekly open", color = st2_col, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = st2_wid)

// ---------- MAIN ----------
mn1_on  = input.bool(true, "Show EMA ribbon",              group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_l1  = input.int(8,   "EMA 1", minval = 1, inline = "mn1a", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_l2  = input.int(26,  "EMA 2", minval = 1, inline = "mn1a", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_l3  = input.int(80,  "EMA 3", minval = 1, inline = "mn1b", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_l4  = input.int(233, "EMA 4", minval = 1, inline = "mn1b", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_c1  = input.color(#ffffff, "", inline = "mn1c", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_c2  = input.color(#fff9c4, "", inline = "mn1c", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_c3  = input.color(#ffeb3b, "", inline = "mn1c", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")
mn1_c4  = input.color(#ff9800, "", inline = "mn1c", group = "Main · EMA ribbon")

mn1_e1 = ta.ema(close, mn1_l1)
mn1_e2 = ta.ema(close, mn1_l2)
mn1_e3 = ta.ema(close, mn1_l3)
mn1_e4 = ta.ema(close, mn1_l4)

plot(mn1_on ? mn1_e1 : na, "EMA 1", color = mn1_c1, linewidth = 1)
plot(mn1_on ? mn1_e2 : na, "EMA 2", color = mn1_c2, linewidth = 1)
plot(mn1_on ? mn1_e3 : na, "EMA 3", color = mn1_c3, linewidth = 1)
plot(mn1_on ? mn1_e4 : na, "EMA 4", color = mn1_c4, linewidth = 2)

// ---------- SIDE ----------
// (none selected)

// ---------- DESSERT ----------
ds1_on  = input.bool(true, "Show weekly summary", group = "Dessert · Weekly summary", tooltip = "A plain summary of the current trading week: where it opened, how far price has moved since, how wide the week's range is, and whereabouts in that range price is sitting now.")
ds1_sz  = input.string("Tiny", "Weekly table text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Dessert · Weekly summary")
ds1_pos = input.string("Top right", "Weekly table position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Dessert · Weekly summary")

[ds1_o, ds1_h, ds1_l, ds1_c, ds1_po, ds1_pc] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", [open, high, low, close, open[1], close[1]], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

ds1_chg   = ds1_o > 0 ? 100.0 * (ds1_c - ds1_o) / ds1_o : 0.0
ds1_rng   = ds1_h - ds1_l
ds1_inr   = ds1_rng > 0 ? 100.0 * (ds1_c - ds1_l) / ds1_rng : 0.0
ds1_pchg  = ds1_po > 0 ? 100.0 * (ds1_pc - ds1_po) / ds1_po : 0.0
ds1_where_in = ds1_inr >= 70 ? "near the high" : ds1_inr <= 30 ? "near the low" : "mid range"
ds1_sign(v) =>
    (v >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(v, "#.##") + "%"

ds1_size = ds1_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : ds1_sz == "Small" ? size.small : ds1_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large
ds1_where = ds1_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : ds1_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : ds1_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table ds1_t = table.new(ds1_where, 2, 6, border_width = 0)
ds1_row(r, k, v, c) =>
    table.cell(ds1_t, 0, r, k, text_color = #6b7280, text_size = ds1_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds1_t, 1, r, v, text_color = c,       text_size = ds1_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

if ds1_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(ds1_t, 0, 0, "THIS WEEK", text_color = #c9a84c, text_size = ds1_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds1_t, 1, 0, "", bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    ds1_row(1, "Opened at",        str.tostring(ds1_o, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds1_row(2, "Moved since open", ds1_sign(ds1_chg), ds1_chg >= 0 ? #c9a84c : #d27050)
    ds1_row(3, "Week's range",     str.tostring(ds1_rng, format.mintick), #f2f0ea)
    ds1_row(4, "Price sitting",    str.tostring(ds1_inr, "#") + "% up, " + ds1_where_in, #f2f0ea)
    ds1_row(5, "Last week ended",  ds1_sign(ds1_pchg), ds1_pchg >= 0 ? #c9a84c : #d27050)
